newsitem.title: USA: ATS receives FDA approval for valve tests.
newsitem.headline: ATS receives FDA approval for valve tests.

text.p: ATS Medical Inc said Tuesaday it has received an investigative device exemption from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, allowing clinical studies for its Open Pivot heart valve.
Although the company anticipates increased revenues during the clinical studies, any additional potential profits would be offset by the increased costs of gathering clinical data, the company said.
The valve will be the first mechanical heart valve to be implanted in the United States under an approved IDE during this decade, ATS said.

"Now that we are well established in the overseas markets with over 12,000 implants in 27 countries, the company is prepared to begin its studies in the United States, which represents almost half of the entire world market," chief executive officer Manny Villafana said. "Although the company anticipates several years of clinical studies prior to approval of its (pre-market approval) application, the announcement of the IDE application approval will have positive effects in increasing its penetration in the international marketplace."
